name: open-universe
description: Reality is an open-source, live-rendering computational grid.

scripts.wasm:build: mkdir -p docs/public/wasm/wake && cd src && bash build.sh
scripts.wasm:check: (test -f docs/public/wasm/wake/planck.wasm && test -f docs/public/wasm/wake/planck-hex.wasm && test docs/public/wasm/wake/planck.wasm -nt src/planck.c && test docs/public/wasm/wake/planck-hex.wasm -nt src/planck.c && test docs/public/wasm/wake/planck.wasm -nt src/build.sh) || (command -v emcc >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run wasm:build) || echo '⚠️ Notice: planck.wasm missing or stale. If testing the simulator locally, build src/ with emsdk.'
scripts.docs:dev: npm run wasm:check && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run wasm:build && vitepress build docs
